title: FragmentReceiver::finalize() silently uses default rule_id
description:
Location: rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs:937

Issue: `self.rule_id.unwrap_or(RULE_ID_A_TO_B)` silently falls back to a default rule ID when `finalize()` is called without any fragment having been received.

Edge case trigger: If `finalize()` is somehow called before receiving any fragments (e.g., after a timeout or via `receive_ack_request()` on a fresh receiver), the rule_id will be None but the code proceeds with a default.

Impact: This could mask logic errors where the receiver processes control messages before actual data, or where protocol state machine transitions are incorrect.

Suggested fix: Either assert that rule_id is Some (indicating a caller bug), or return an InvalidState error when finalize() is called with no rule_id set.
